name: architexture-controlnet-ptd-1742
description: Exact 1,742-sample ControlNet-stitched PTD evaluation set used for the NeurIPS 2026 submission appendix results (Table 15, Supporting Route E). Label-symmetric binary partitions generated via ControlNet-conditioned stitched-regeneration pipeline. ARCHITEXTURE Stage-A: all-1742, 1742/1742, invariant mIoU=0.6803, ARI=0.6039.
rai:dataLimitations: This dataset targets texture-defined binary partitioning under synthetic ControlNet-stitched bridge conditions. It should not be used as a general semantic segmentation benchmark, for object recognition, or as evidence of performance on safety-critical domains.
rai:dataBiases: Inherits biases from DTD source texture distributions, the ControlNet/Stable Diffusion v1.5 generation process, prompt choices, and binary partition construction via geometric stitching. May overrepresent clean two-region transitions.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No intentional human-subject, biometric, demographic, medical-identifying, or private personal information is included. All images are synthetically generated stitched texture pairs.
rai:dataUseCases: Research on texture-aware segmentation, binary partition evaluation, proposal-bank consolidation, synthetic-to-natural bridge benchmarks, and reproducibility of the NeurIPS 2026 appendix ControlNet-stitched PTD route.
rai:notRecommendedUses: General semantic segmentation benchmark claims, human identity tasks, surveillance, medical diagnosis, or safety-critical deployment.
prov:wasDerivedFrom: DTD (Describable Textures Dataset, CC-BY 4.0); ControlNet conditioned on Stable Diffusion v1.5 (CreativeML Open RAIL-M); PTD stitched-regeneration pipeline
prov:wasGeneratedBy: ControlNet-conditioned stitched-regeneration pipeline: source textures from DTD, pairs stitched via binary geometric masks, regenerated through ControlNet. Binary GT masks from stitching geometry (label-symmetric). Filtered to 1,742 samples with valid partition structure.

distribution.name: manifest.csv
distribution.description: One row per sample: sample_id, image_path, mask_path, split, label_symmetric, eval_included
